name: glass-surface
title: Glass surface
description: The glass material: a poster and a CSS-blurred panel with no script, upgraded to a three.js refraction pass only when the gate says webgl and a 12-frame probe stays under 8 ms. Pauses off screen; one teardown.
docs: Relative imports between the installed files use .ts extensions; set allowImportingTsExtensions: true in tsconfig (Next.js has noEmit, so it is allowed). Needs the @starlight namespace in components.json registries, which resolves glass-gate, material and materials-styles.
